visualReview.notes: All ten current standard frames inspected. The seven sail ribs, two-plane crossed rigging, open exterior stair flights and handrails, circular gallery, corrected regular hexagonal dome network, C-section mast and curved hotel wings remain continuous and legible from both sides.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All ten current shared-material frames inspected. White structural metal, neutral concrete and tinted curtain glazing preserve their distinct appearances. The hexagonal dome framework now stays above the glass instead of dissolving or overlapping; facade bands and glass window divisions remain intact at close range.

geographicReview.notes: The north-up view agrees with the mapped hotel, mast and seven individual sail-rib plans. The narrow structural axis follows the measured directed frame and the taller hotel roof is on its mapped eastern side. Separate mapped entrance and ground canopies legitimately project beyond the main QID outline; native published 145 m tip and source-mapped gallery elevations are retained without uniform fitting.

fidelityReview.notes: Passed for the complete current detailed exterior: operator photos, exact building parts and mapped height stages establish the asymmetrical mast, seven curved sail ribs, exposed stairs and rigging, present glazed viewing dome, hotel wings and ground canopy ensemble. Minor branding and signage are omitted; glazing is a tinted static exterior representation rather than an interior reconstruction.
